b2.erin_cooks_corusdeer_soup_against_the.summary: In Octavia's wrecked kitchen Erin tames Corusdeer horn with flour and cold carrots into a fiery soup. Through [Wondrous Fare] it keeps Ryoka warm enough to walk the winter streets barefoot in shorts, and Octavia wants the recipe.

canon_ref.note: A costly message office on the Runners' Guild street, not the Mages' Guild. Clerks write every text out before it is sent, so nothing sent is private.

b2.erin_and_ryoka_send_messages_to_lisco.summary: They pay a clerk to send [Message] spells to Liscor: Erin tells Selys, Krshia and Klbkch she is well, and Ryoka tells Krshia alone that she has what the tribe needs and they must wait for her return.

canon_ref.note: Agnes's husband Jerom is off-page and gets no npc entry. The barmaids are Maran and Safry. Garia stays at the Hare often because it is cheap.

b2.erin_takes_over_the_frenzied_hares_ki.summary: Over Ryoka's doubts, Erin picks the run-down Frenzied Hare, kept by Agnes, a former [Tailor], while her husband, the cook, is ill. Pitying the poor food, Erin takes over the kitchen, and Garia finds Ryoka there as hamburgers pour out.

stage.line: A drunk Brilliant Sword slaps Erin as she turns away, and his four friends lurch up from their table.

waves.line: Erin spins round and punches him clean out of his chair.
Regulars who have had enough of the Brilliant Swords pile in behind Erin.

stage.note: M8.7: four Bronze-rank and one Silver-rank adventurer. Ryoka and Garia fight too but have no npc_behaviour entry, so they keep story roles and are not placed. The regulars are a design helper wave; in the text most guests flee.

b2.bar_fight_with_the_brilliant_swords.summary: Five drunk adventurers, the Brilliant Swords of Celum, grope Safry and Maran. Erin asks them nicely to stop; when one slaps her rear, she breaks his nose and takes on all five, with Ryoka kicking and Garia hurling one into a wall.
